_doc: Referee round, steps 4-5 (referee-adjudication skill): f1, one writer per section applies the ACCEPT and ACCEPT
MODIFIED items of the adjudication in copies of its own files; c1, a confirmation reviewer compares the proposal
with the live files (packet root) against the adjudication and the Lean; v1 writes STATUS = INTEGRATE or NOT YET.
Only for units marked NOT YET: f2, a fix-up writer applies the fixes of c1/confirm.md to a copy of the f1
proposal; c2, a second confirmation (the c1 prompt plus reconfirmation.md, with the first report in the packet);
v2 writes STATUS again. A unit still NOT YET goes to the editor, or to another round under new stage names
(f3, c3, v3): a stage with a .done marker never runs again. 'spine' is the natural spine, the authority for
statements. Copy this file to <working repository>/rollout/, replace every SET-ME value, run with --dry-run
first. 'files' is a path or glob relative to the manuscript; the three units are examples from the Yang-Mills

vars.manuscript: SET-ME: the canonical manuscript directory (main.tex, part1/, part2/, main.pdf)
vars.referees: SET-ME: the workdir of the referee run
vars.adjudications: SET-ME: the workdir of the adjudication run
vars.lean: SET-ME: the Lean source at the pinned commit
vars.graph_db: SET-ME: the dependency database built by lean-dependency-graph
vars.graph_hint: query the dependency database with sqlite3 -readonly {{graph_db}} (table nodes: name, kind, module, path, line, used); only rows with used = 1 count
vars.main_theorems: SET-ME: the labels of the main theorems, e.g. thm:main and thm:formal
